newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.010pts to 102.412.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.010pts to 102.412.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.010 points in Wednesday's trading to 102.412, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.378 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell by 0.018 points to 99.063 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.245 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.209 points to 1,070.542.
